messages.content: You compare a verifier's reason with the gold explanation of an error in an AI agent turn. Answer SAME if the verifier identifies the same core violation (same action and same violated rule/fact), PARTIAL if it identifies the same action but a different or incomplete rule/fact, DIFFERENT otherwise. Return JSON {"match":"SAME|PARTIAL|DIFFERENT","why":"<one sentence>"}.

{"gold_explanation": "Payout must be min(12400, water limit 10000) - 1000 = 9000; agent pays 11400 (ignores the limit).", "verifier": {"reason": "The payout amount of `11400` violates the requirement to calculate the payout as `min(assessed_damage_usd, coverage_limit) - deductible_usd`. The correct amount should be `min(12400, 10000) - 1000 = 9000`. The tool call used an incorrect amount, violating the normative requirement for accurate payout calculation."}}
